records.name: nizima ACTION!!
records.tagline: Powerful editing, expressive characters, zero installs.
records.description: nizima ACTION!! by Live2D Inc. is a browser video editor that works like a design tool. Despite running entirely in your browser, it delivers advanced editing with nested scenes, precise cuts, and keyframe-based animation. Plus, by using Live2D, the industry standard for VTubers, you can create engaging videos with expressive 2D characters. Free in beta.

records.name: bonds chat
records.tagline: Multiplayer AI that dies if you and your friends flake
records.description: Every AI is built for one person. Remember Tamagotchi? 💀 bondi is like one that lives in your friends chat and belongs to the group. Say “30 days of gym” and it sets up the challenge. Everyone checks in with a photo, and doing real things together gives it lives ❤️❤️❤️. Go quiet and it starts losing them. At zero it dies. It also makes games, stickers, countdowns and videos right in the chat. Free on iPhone, web and Mac.

records.name: Kippy AI
records.tagline: Learn languages while having fun!
records.description: Fluency is hard, being understood is easier. Kippy is your AI speaking partner for language learning. Not your usual AI sycophant tutor but rather personalities that care just a little more about themselves than you, while they teach you a new language.

records.name: Mister Blocks
records.tagline: Take a picture of your LEGO and AI will make a build
records.description: Take a photo of the loose bricks on your table. Mister Blocks (powered by Claude) looks at what you actually have and suggests a few things to build from them, each with 3D step-by-step instructions you can turn, zoom and print. Don't like it? Ask the chat for changes. No pile handy? Describe a build in words and get one, from a robot dog to a voxel sculpture of a sports car. Every build is stud-checked. Free guides work offline.

records.name: Valin
records.tagline: Your private memory for everything you save.
records.description: For people who save videos, posts, articles and documents across apps and can't find them when they need them, Valin is the private memory app that understands what you save, down to what's said in a video, so you can find information you don't even remember saving. Unlike other AI bookmarking apps, Valin's AI runs entirely on your device, so only you can see what you save. No account, no cloud, no AI subscription.

records.name: Shot.video
records.tagline: Multi-camera videos with the phones you already own
records.description: Most people record with one camera, because more angles feel too hard. Shot.video turns your laptop and phones into a multi-camera studio. Scan a QR code and a phone becomes another camera, with no app to install. Press record once. Every angle records in sync, then AI makes your first edit. It cuts to the camera you're looking at and adds zooms, punch-ins and optional B-roll. Change anything you like. Free to start. No card needed.

records.name: Nod by n8n
records.tagline: Open source personal agent with its own computer
records.description: Nod does the work around your work, in your apps and on real websites, using a private computer of its own on your Mac or PC. It takes orders only from you, asks before anything you didn't ask for, and runs on the AI provider you choose. Free, Apache 2.0.

records.name: Reddit Reviews
records.tagline: Product pages that collect subreddit sentiment
records.description: Discover Reddit Reviews, a new experience that organizes product conversations and highlights the most important takeaways from across our communities.

records.name: ScroogeFrog AI
records.tagline: AI ad fraud detection that protects your marketing budget
records.description: ScroogeFrog AI helps advertisers find out where their ad budget is going to waste. It audits website traffic and Google Ads campaigns to uncover suspicious clicks, bot activity, and underperforming spend, then turns complex data into clear recommendations on what to fix. For agencies and larger advertisers, it also offers custom AI fraud detection models trained on their own traffic data. Less guesswork, more control over every advertising dollar.

records.name: Muse Ember by Meta
records.tagline: Meta's low-cost AI model for high-volume agent tasks
records.description: Muse Ember is Meta's smallest multimodal reasoning model, built to handle the repetitive work behind AI agents. From tool calls and coding subtasks to document extraction and routing, Ember delivers efficient execution at scale. It supports text, images, audio, and video, with a 1M-token context window and pricing starting at $0.10 per million input tokens. Pair it with larger models for planning, and let Ember handle the volume. Available through Meta Model API and Muse Code.

records.name: MiniMax H3-Image
records.tagline: Bringing 4K image generation into the 10-second era
records.description: MiniMax H3-Image is an open-weight model for native 16MP image generation and editing. It uses just six diffusion steps, handles text-to-image and editing in one checkpoint, and supports up to 16 reference images.

records.name: Scribe v3 by ElevenLabs
records.tagline: Speech to text with 27% fewer errors in 90+ languages
records.description: Scribe v3 is ElevenLabs’ most accurate speech-to-text model, for developers building on calls, meetings, interviews and media. It makes 27% fewer word errors than Scribe v2 across 90+ languages. Unlike transcription that breaks on noise, accents and crosstalk, it labels up to 32 speakers, tags laughter, music and emotion, boosts up to 1,000 of your own terms, detects 56 entity types and handles files up to 15 hours. For live use, Scribe v3 Live runs under 150ms.

records.name: Relay
records.tagline: DocSend for AI agents: send and receive docs with context
records.description: You send a deck or doc. They ask their AI to read it. The AI sees what's on the page, but not the thinking behind it: why you made those choices, what you left out, or what's still open. Relay shares that context with your document, so they and their AI can understand it and ask questions. You choose what to share. Decisions that need your input, like a discount or a date, come back to you. Try a sample relay. No sign-up needed.

records.name: Earlybird
records.tagline: 29M-param speech-to-text that outputs words before they end
records.description: Earlybird is a 29M-parameter, 17 MB on-device speech-to-text model that predicts each word correctly about 90 ms before the speaker finishes it, with a confidence on every word. Built for voice agents that need to act sooner. Open weights and code.

records.name: Seedream 5.5 by ByteDance
records.tagline: ByteDance's AI image model built for 100-round editing
records.description: Seedream 5.5 is ByteDance's latest AI image model, built for creators who want to keep refining their work without starting over. Make up to 100 rounds of targeted edits while preserving untouched areas at the pixel level. Generate reusable assets with native transparent backgrounds, create more realistic images with natural lighting and textures, and render detailed text more accurately.

records.name: Skillbox
records.tagline: One library for your AI skills, synced to every agent
records.description: Skillbox keeps your AI skills in one library and syncs them to Claude Code, Cursor and Codex. Follow GitHub sources, review diffs, and scan each version for prompt injection. Trim shortens noisy command output so sessions last longer.

records.name: Xolace
records.tagline: For the bad days you wouldn’t call a mental health problem
records.description: Feeling off but can’t say why? Type it out, or talk it through by voice. Xolace shows you what’s underneath, then hands you steps that fit: a chat with a trained peer supporter, help writing to someone you trust, or guided audio. Reflecting is free.

records.name: CALL-E
records.tagline: The phone line for AI agents
records.description: CALL-E lets your AI assistant make phone calls for you. Ask ChatGPT or Claude to book a table, get a quote, move an appointment or check stock. CALL-E asks for anything missing, shows you the plan, and dials a real US or Canadian number after you confirm. It gets through phone menus, hold and voicemail, then brings back a summary, the transcript and what happened. Builders can add it to Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or OpenClaw with one prompt. New users get 100 free credits.

records.name: StableBar
records.tagline: A native, open-source menu bar for macOS
records.description: StableBar is a free, open-source menu bar for macOS written in Swift. Set it up in a Settings window or one JSON file instead of shell scripts. It shows AeroSpace, yabai or OmniWM workspaces, widgets with popups and seven themes, and you edit it on the bar.

records.name: Padrail
records.tagline: Turn your MacBook trackpad edges into controls
records.description: Padrail turns the edges of your MacBook trackpad into sliders: volume on the right, brightness on the left, keyboard light at the bottom, and a top edge that changes with the app (tabs, zoom, next track). Free, no account, lives in the menu bar.

records.name: Mitra MCP
records.tagline: Give your AI agents access to your personal phone line
records.description: Most AI agents can’t call. Those that can often use unfamiliar numbers that get blocked or flagged as spam. Even when someone picks up, a successful voice conversation needs different context handling than a text chat. Mitra MCP lets your agent call from your personal number, with a calling experience built for live conversations and the ability to bring you in when needed.

records.name: RigSpark
records.tagline: Know which AI to run on your own computer
records.description: Run open AI models on your own computer: chat, images, video and voice. RigSpark checks your memory, GPU and disk first and shows what will actually run. No account, no cloud, no meter. Free and open source (MIT), in Rust, for macOS, Windows and Linux.

records.name: Subscriptrack
records.tagline: Connect your email, see every subscription you pay for
records.description: Connect your email and AI finds every subscription: one list, your monthly total, alerts before renewals and trial ends, cancel steps for 200+ services. Outlook in one click, Gmail and any inbox by forwarding. Never asks for bank logins. Free for 5.

records.name: Stiro
records.tagline: AI onboarding and customer success agent for SaaS
records.description: Add Stiro to your SaaS with one script tag. When a user gets stuck or asks for something, it does the steps with them in your real product while they watch. Anything that sends, spends or deletes goes back to them. Built to cut how-do-I tickets.

records.name: Skipbox
records.tagline: Cheap, fast GitHub Actions runners with unlimited minutes
records.description: Skipbox runs your GitHub Actions jobs on your own Linux VM, kept between jobs, so Docker layers, package caches and installed tools are still there on the next run. Credentials, the workspace and every container are wiped after each job. A flat monthly price with unlimited minutes: $39 for 4 vCPU / 8 GB. Install the GitHub App and change one line to runs-on: skipbox. 7-day free trial, no card. Private repositories only.

records.name: Binqo
records.tagline: A tiny friend in your Mac's notch
records.description: Binqo puts Mielo, a little dot-matrix friend, in your Mac's notch. Glance up for music, calendar, files and clipboard. Hold a key to ask a question, answered on your Mac. Open the desk for meeting notes and mini-apps you describe in a sentence.

records.name: ViralAri
records.tagline: See why your video flops, and fix it in a minute.
records.description: Editors make your video look good. ViralAri makes sure people actually watch it. Most videos fail in the first 3 seconds if the point arrives too late, opening is a greeting, nothing on screen tells a silent scroller why to stay. Platforms test every video on a small group first, so a weak opening is bad. ViralAri catches that. Upload any video and Ari shows the second viewers leave, explains why, rewrites your opening, and hands you a fixed, captioned, tighter video.

records.name: ArrowOut: Clear & Escape
records.tagline: Clear arrows. Find your calm.
records.description: A clear path. A thoughtful tap. One more puzzle. ArrowOut is a minimalist arrow escape game for iPhone and iPad. Look closely, find an arrow with a clear way out, and tap to send it off the board. Clear every arrow to move on. THINK BEFORE YOU TAP Arrows can block one another. Work out the order, follow the paths, and make space for the next move. In standard mode, you start with three hearts; a blocked move costs one. Reset the board freely and try a fresh approach.

records.name: mydigitalcoachbot
records.tagline: Your assistant and motivator in your phone 24/7!
records.description: 🎯 What does it offer? It helps you organize your thoughts, figure out what you truly want in life, and reach your goals more easily. 💼 Why do you need it? In our daily rush, we often forget about ourselves. This bot acts like a wise friend on your smartphone—always by your side and ready to listen.

records.name: EasyView
records.tagline: Any website, Redesigned for you
records.description: Developers have had all the control until now. We built something to give it back to the users. ☠️ EasyView — built for everyone. Whether you're a student, a professional, or even a developer yourself! 😗 Customise any website with a single click or simply tell it what you want. Change layouts with the Morph Engine, hide WhatsApp chats and Gmail while screen sharing, simplify and change confusing text right in the UI with smart tooltips, sticky notes, and much more. See the web your way. 🫴💫

records.name: GuaraPay
records.tagline: Virtual dollar cards in 2 min, with MCP for your AI agent
records.description: GuaraPay issues virtual dollar cards in about 2 minutes. Top up with USDT or a bank card and pay for subscriptions, apps and online stores worldwide, from the web app or Telegram. Plus MCP: switch any card to AI agent mode and connect mcp.guarapay.io to ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor or any MCP client. The agent pays within limits you set in the app, asks you above them, and the card stays frozen between purchases.

records.name: MacChain
records.tagline: A scrolling window manager for Mac. Stop stacking.
records.description: Your Mac stacks windows on top of each other, so every window you open buries the last one. MacChain does the opposite — every window lines up side by side on one endless strip. Nothing overlaps, nothing hides, and opening one more app never shrinks the rest. Scroll your workspace with a three-finger swipe. $14 once. Every update included. No subscription. Try the whole thing free in your browser before you install anything.

records.name: Wisdom Effect
records.tagline: Build Amazon KDP puzzle books
records.description: Browser-based Amazon KDP puzzle book generator and layout studio for the interior and the full paperback cover. Generate unique Sudoku, Word Search, Maze, Word Scramble, Missing Vowels, Cryptogram, Wordoku and mixed books with automated gutter and safe margin compliance, a cover sized from the page count, custom fonts, and vector export.

records.name: QR Code Scanner & Generator
records.tagline: Scan QR codes, create custom codes, documents to PDFs.
records.description: Scan a code, create your own, or turn a paper document into a PDF. QR Code Scanner & Generator brings everyday scanning and sharing tools together in one app. Use your camera to read QR codes and supported barcode formats, or choose an image from your gallery. Tap the camera preview to focus, use the flashlight in low light, and scan continuously with batch mode. See the actual destination domain before opening a scanned web link.

records.name: CROGuys Store Audit
records.tagline: Audits of Shopify stores with prioritized fixes and report.
records.description: CROGuys Store Audit finds where a Shopify store loses sales and tells you what to fix first. It reviews the public storefront in a real browser and produces a conversion-readiness score out of 100 with a PDF report. Findings include priorities, evidence, expected lift ranges, implementation steps, and A/B test plans. No Shopify admin, orders, or customer data access is required.

records.name: Bhave Botox (Shampoo + Conditioner)
records.tagline: Shampoo + Conditioner
records.description: Key Benefits Deep Hair Repair  Helps restore damaged, chemically treated, and weak hair Intense Hydration  Locks in moisture to keep hair soft and nourished all day Frizz Control  Smoothens hair and reduces frizz for a sleek look Strengthens Hair  Enriched with keratin to improve hair strength and elasticity Adds Shine & Smoothness  Leaves hair silky, shiny, and manageable Ideal for Daily Use  Gentle formula suitable for regular hair care routine Botox Effect for…

records.name: LoafCoach: Sourdough Bread
records.tagline: Dough Calculator & Starter Log
records.description: Imagine the smell of fresh sourdough filling your kitchen, and knowing you made it yourself. There is nothing quite like it. The crust crackles softly as the loaf cools on the counter. You tear into a warm slice, the crumb is open and tender, and you made it with nothing more than flour, water, salt and a little patience. Sourdough has a reputation for being hard and confusing. LoafCoach makes it simple.

records.name: Vitrion Layout Studio
records.tagline: Draw a house to size, walk it in 3D on your phone
records.description: Draw your house in the browser at true size, in feet and inches or metric. Press Make it 3D and the plan becomes a walk-through at eye level, with photos of every room. Then send one link: your client, your builder or your family walks every room on a phone, with no account and nothing to install. Start from a blank page, a photo of a hand sketch, or a DWG, DXF or PDF. Early access is open now. Layout Studio opens to everyone on 1 December.

records.name: Typing Master With Certificate
records.tagline: Free Online Typing Test in English (WPM and Certificate)
records.description: Take a free online typing test in English to learn your WPM speed and accuracy with a 1 minute typing test, smash a 60-second test, or type paragraphs for 5 minutes with a free WPM certificate.

records.name: HP 65W Laptop Charger for 6800 Series
records.tagline: Reliable HP laptop charger with compatible adapter
records.description: HP 65W Laptop Charger for 6800 6820s N1020v Series With Free Power/Flower Cord With this HP 65W Laptop Charger for 6800 6820s N1020v Series 19.5V 3.33A 7.4mm x 5.0mm, You can expect the same top-quality performance as you received with your original laptop charger, because it features the exact same specifications as any genuine charger. Therefore, you do not need to worry about the reliability of our products. For this reason, we also provide 1 month replacement warranty.

records.name: Banner Bouncer
records.tagline: Say no to every cookie banner, automatically.
records.description: You know this feeling: another site, another cookie banner. Accept takes one tap, Reject takes five. Banner Bouncer is a free Safari extension for iPhone that just says no for you, in 35 languages, and logs every refusal. Nothing leaves your device.

records.name: MyFinanceBook
records.tagline: AI income & expense tracker, no bank login
records.description: An AI-powered income and expense tracker built from the bank statements you export (PDF or CSV). Nobody connects to your bank. You review every row before it's saved. Then ask Claude where your money went. Claude can read your ledger and add to it, while edits and deletions stay with you, by design. The connector is free on every Claude plan. Foreign rows use the rate for each transaction's own date (13 ledger currencies). Ledger, reports, export and connector are free forever.

records.name: fahadclean
records.tagline: Carpet Cleaning Service in Kuwait
records.description: A clean carpet can make your home, apartment, villa or office look more comfortable and welcoming. Carpet Cleaning Service from Fahad Clean is designed to help remove everyday dust, dirt, stains and accumulated debris from carpets while improving the overall appearance of your space.

records.name: DNSvivo
records.tagline: Free DNS failover, weighted load balancing, and DDNS
records.description: DNSvivo is a free managed DNS service with automatic failover, weighted load balancing, and Dynamic DNS (DDNS). It checks IP addresses from five locations and stops returning unhealthy IPs in DNS responses. You can set weights for healthy IPs and update records when your public IP changes. The free plan includes 2 domains, 5 monitored IPs, and 3 DDNS records.

records.name: SelfShelf
records.tagline: Your reading life, all on one shelf.
records.description: SelfShelf is your own little corner of the internet for all things books. 📚 Create a beautiful digital bookshelf, organise your collection, track your reading progress, save favourite quotes, and keep a personal journal for every book. Whether you're keeping track of your next reads or holding on to stories that touched your heart, SelfShelf gives your reading life a place of its own. Build your shelf, make it yours, and share your love for books. ♡

records.name: AI Content Team
records.tagline: Stop chatting with AI. Delegate to an AI content pipeline
records.description: Stop copy pasting prompts across chat tabs. AI Content Team runs your idea through specialized AI roles, from Planner to Writer to Editor, across 9 workflows, so solo founders and creators can turn raw notes into YouTube scripts, Reddit posts and launch kits.

records.name: Specita
records.tagline: Release tracking for web, API and mobile apps
records.description: Specita gives each product a shared home, with its website, API and mobile apps on their own timelines. Every release gets a short brief: what changed, where it shipped, and what needs attention. Connect GitHub, CI, Google Play, App Store Connect, Sentry and Slack, or start with a manual record. Delivery, source risk and runtime evidence stay separate, and missing evidence shows as unknown. Assign an owner and keep the response with the release. Free to start.

records.name: eStockes
records.tagline: Test stock trading rules against buy and hold
records.description: eStockes helps individual investors research US stocks and ETFs. Reality Check lets you test a trading rule on historical daily prices without coding or creating an account, then compare it with buying and holding. See modeled trading costs, returns, drawdown, trade counts, and method limitations. Explore charts, screening tools, and free lessons for further research. Historical simulations are not predictions or financial advice.

records.name: Got a product that deserves

records.description: Confluence can only watch one person at a time. Group Watchers maps a group to a space or page, so every member becomes a watcher, new members are added and leavers removed every hour. People who unwatch are never added back.

records.name: Glide - Trackpad Edge Gestures
records.tagline: Effortless brightness & volume edge gestures for Mac
records.description: Control your MacBook screen brightness and sound volume by simply sliding your finger along the edges of your trackpad — with realistic Force Touch haptics, zero permissions, and zero bloat. Stop reaching for function keys or digging through Control Center sliders. Glide turns the unused left and right borders of your trackpad into smooth, natural adjustment rails.

records.name: Vary AI
records.tagline: A local AI management and security gateway for AI coding.
records.description: Vary AI is a local AI management and security gateway for AI Coding and AI Agent users. It provides unified management of providers, usage, and spending, detects sensitive information before requests leave the network, and alerts on dangerous tool calls.

records.name: Sweatpea
records.tagline: Your Mac has a temperature. And a suspect.
records.description: Sweatpea is a little green pea that lives in your Mac's menu bar and reacts to how hard your Mac is working. Chill, warm, sweating, meltdown. Click it and it names the app responsible, explains macOS processes in plain English, and offers a polite Quit. It also tracks memory and storage, and asks you to take a two-minute break every hour. About 1% of one core. No account, no analytics. Free, with Pro at $9.99 once.

records.name: GTA VI Radio
records.tagline: Every GTA VI radio station
records.description: An unofficial, fan-made website about the radio stations of Grand Theft Auto VI.

records.name: Flow Automator for Google Flow
records.tagline: Completely free. No signup, no login required. Automate Flow
records.description: Free!!Automate bulk image & video generation on Google Flow. Queue prompts, customize models, and auto-download results.

records.name: ConvertImg.com
records.tagline: Free Online Image Converter, Compressor, Resizer & more
records.description: ConvertImg | Easily convert, compress, resize, & more with your images online. It's 100% free, easy to use, secure, and works on all browsers.

records.name: Indigo
records.tagline: AI Longevity & Habit Tracker App
records.description: Indigo is an AI longevity and habit tracker for iPhone and Android. Build healthy daily habits — no calorie counting, no confusing charts — track your rate of aging and get check-ins from an AI friend. Free.

records.name: Cyber Insurance Application Scanner
records.tagline: The controls a carrier application asks for
records.description: Paste a carrier cyber application question set, or pick a carrier, and see the ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST CSF 2.0, Essential Eight, CPS 234, CIS Controls v8 and PCI DSS 4.0 controls each question tests, with the evidence to gather and the source question beside every row.

records.name: $2,300 Google Play Giveaway: Free Entry
records.tagline: $2,300 Google Play Giveaway: Free Entry, 7 Countries
records.description: Enter our free giveaway for a chance to win $2,300. Open to Argentina, Indonesia, Turkey, Vietnam, USA, Canada and Germany.

records.name: Skepsis
records.tagline: A free game for the Greek roots hiding in everyday English
records.description: A free, open-source game that teaches the Greek roots hiding in everyday English, in 3-minute lessons. Knowing what words mean helps you think clearly. I'm trying to help Texans learn Greek, so every word has a Texas example. No account, no ads.

records.name: Mentide
records.tagline: Mentide is a private notebook that stays on your device
records.description: Write locally. Link your thoughts. See the graph. Mentide is a private notebook that stays on your device — free for life.

records.name: Ai Me Bro
records.tagline: Learn AI, grab prompts and agents, and stay current
records.description: Guides, prompts and agent templates for ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok and more. 55 guides, 248 agent templates by job, side-by-side comparisons and a Daily AI News feed. Built for total beginners and seasoned engineers alike. Free to join.

records.name: Nimply Design
records.tagline: Design your social posts right where you schedule them
records.description: Nimply Design is a design editor built into Nimply, the social media tool. Start from 5,000+ templates in 40 platform sizes, keep every graphic on brand with brand kits, fix photos with AI tools, and turn a flat image back into editable layers with Magic Layers. Or let the Designer agent draft it in your brand. When it is ready, send it straight into a post for approval and scheduling: no downloading and re-uploading. Free plan included. AI tools use credits and show the cost first.

records.name: Sendonia
records.tagline: Email & SMS Marketing Platform for Small Businesses
records.description: Sendonia is an email and SMS marketing platform for small businesses, agencies and freelancers. Send newsletters and email campaigns from your own domain on Amazon SES (EU or US), with guided DKIM, SPF and DMARC setup, a domain health score and bot-filtered analytics for better inbox deliverability. GDPR-friendly, with every feature and unlimited seats on every plan and no overage fees. SMS campaigns are in early access. An affordable Mailchimp alternative from $15/month.

records.name: $2,300 Google Play Gift Card Giveaway
records.tagline: $2,300 Google Play Gift Card Giveaway: Ends Nov 24
records.description: One reader wins Google Play gift cards worth $2,300. Enter with your name, email and country. No purchase needed. Winner announced November 26.

records.name: stocksbrew
records.tagline: A research analyst for every stock you own
records.description: stocksbrew reads the filings, earnings and news for every US stock, then tells you why it moved, what changed and what's worth a look next. Every stock page, call and backtest is free to read. Watch as many stocks as you like; 5 get the full agent free.

records.name: Dos and Don'ts
records.tagline: Know before you go...
records.description: Discover dos and don'ts for places worldwide. Search any city or attraction and get concise, actionable guidance.

records.name: Waymark
records.tagline: A map that starts in fog and clears where you walk
records.description: A comprehensive map of everywhere you've been. The map starts out in fog, and every walk, ride or drive clears a little more. Old photos fill in the years before you installed it! No account, no ads, and nothing leaves your iPhone. Free, or $5.99 once for Plus.

records.name: Learn Thai with Flashcards
records.tagline: Free Thai vocabulary course
records.description: Free Thai vocabulary course: 462 lessons and 4,778 words with Thai script, romanization, English and audio. Flashcards and quiz, no sign-up. Gamified learning.

records.name: My Perfect Day
records.tagline: Plan your perfect day. Habits, workouts, stats.
records.description: Leg fest, wie ein perfekter Tag für dich aussieht. Dann öffne die App und sieh, wie viel davon du schon geschafft hast.

records.name: $2,300 Google Play Giveaway Rules
records.tagline: $2,300 Google Play Giveaway Rules, Dates and Prize
records.description: Read the full rules: who can enter, how the winner is picked and when the prize is sent. Not affiliated with Google.

records.name: NomadGpu
records.tagline: Your fine-tune survives the host dying
records.description: NomadGPU runs training jobs on your own Vast.ai account. If the machine dies mid-run, it rents another one and resumes from the last checkpoint. Hard spending limits, Telegram alerts and a live status page. 14 days free.

records.name: Get Canva Pro FREE for 30 Days!
records.tagline: #freecanvapro #canva #canvapremium
records.description: 🔗 **VISIT THE LINK BELOW TO CLAIM YOUR OFFER! 👇** Here: https://bit.ly/48abBFo 🎨 Want Canva Premium for FREE? Unlock premium templates, Magic Tools, millions of design elements, and more! 🔥 **Get 30 Days of Premium Access for FREE!** ⏳ Limited-time offer — don't miss out! 👇 **VISIT THE LINK NOW!**

records.name: edms
records.tagline: Accelerate microservice development for a team
records.description: Endpoint Data Management System (EDMS). Gp through Readme / Wikis https://github.com/hashedtokens/edms

records.name: WritePDF
records.tagline: Client Review and Approval Software
records.description: Collect client feedback, revisions, and approvals for documents, websites, and images in one place.

records.name: captioncat
records.tagline: scroll-stopping captions for creators and their agents
records.description: turn video or audio into share-ready clips with expressive, scroll-stopping captions. use captioncat yourself or with your ai agents to transcribe, design, and render captions for podcast clips, talking-head videos, storytimes, news clips, reels, tiktoks, youtube shorts, vlogs, karaoke videos, and more. start with 36 handcrafted presets or create your own in preset studio. free and open-source.

records.name: Claim Fund
records.tagline: $13M in unclaimed PumpFun fees. Is any of it yours?
records.description: Claim Fund lets you check up to 10 Solana wallets for unclaimed creator fees and trader cashback, without connecting. Found something? Connect your wallet to check your live balance and claim what’s yours. No PumpFun login needed. You stay in control, with every transaction approved in your wallet.

records.name: nanofile
records.tagline: Compress 36 file formats in your browser, nothing uploaded
records.description: Compress images, PDFs, Office docs, audio, fonts and code entirely in your browser tab. There is no upload endpoint at all, so your files never leave your device. 36 formats, batches, before/after preview, no account, no watermark, no limits.

records.name: Ascope
records.tagline: Daily App Store & Google Play keyword ranks, on your Mac
records.description: Ascope checks where your apps rank in App Store and Google Play search in 50+ countries every day, with popularity and difficulty for every keyword. Native Mac app, no dashboard, no account. Ask Claude or Cursor about your rankings via the built-in MCP server.

records.name: Abroad Life: Visas & Residency
records.tagline: Lifestyle
records.description: Stop wasting time figuring out how to move to Spain. Abroad turns a complex, fragmented immigration process into one clear journey. Know exactly what to do and when, avoid unnecessary paperwork and costly mistakes, and move forward with the support of AI-powered document checks and a dedicated immigration lawyer. Manage your entire process, track progress and get answers in one place. Less time figuring things out. More time building your life in Spain. Built by migrants, for migrants.

records.name: TigerGate
records.tagline: Secure code, cloud and runtime, and stay audit-ready
records.description: Code-to-cloud security: SAST, SCA, secrets, IaC, DAST, CSPM, KSPM, container security, AI-SPM and eBPF runtime protection with compliance automation for SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI-DSS, HIPAA and CERT-In.

records.name: Umber
records.tagline: Stop copying files. Stream them from one source.
records.description: Store every image, video, audio file, document and 3D model once, version it, deploy a version to each environment, and serve it to every app from one stable URL — no rebuild or app release to upgrade an asset. Less storage and management cost. Access via Dashboard, REST API and CLI. Free plan available.

records.name: MotorHangar
records.tagline: Check any car for recalls, free, in 4 languages
records.description: Official recalls, safety ratings and owner complaints for 13,000+ car models and years, free, no sign-up. See which year to avoid, fuel economy in your units and where to check your VIN in your country. In English, Spanish, German and French.

records.name: Saviours AI
records.tagline: All-in-one ICSE Class 10 board prep, from plan to paper
records.description: Nine AI-powered tools built end to end for the ICSE Class 10 syllabus. Start free. ICSE Class 10 prep is scattered across PDFs, videos and chats. Saviours AI puts it in one place: a smart study planner, a 60-day pre-board plan, timed specimen papers, PYQ practice, history timelines and physics numericals. Start free, Pro is ₹99 one-time.

records.name: HermesMarkdown
records.tagline: Markdown editor that saves straight to your folder. No cloud
records.description: Open a folder in Chrome or Edge and edit your Markdown files right where they are on disk. Works with existing Obsidian vaults, supports [[wikilinks]], Vim mode and live embeds, and works offline. No accounts, no cloud. Free and open source.

records.name: Skipbox
records.tagline: Cheap, fast GitHub Actions runners with unlimited minutes
records.description: Skipbox runs your GitHub Actions jobs on your own Linux VM, kept between jobs, so Docker layers, package caches and installed tools are still there on the next run. Credentials, the workspace and every container are wiped after each job. A flat monthly price with unlimited minutes: $39 for 4 vCPU / 8 GB. Install the GitHub App and change one line to runs-on: skipbox. 7-day free trial, no card. Private repositories only.

records.name: oncemore
records.tagline: Private network for builders who kept going
records.description: A members-only directory and working network for active builders who reached the final interview stage of a top accelerator and were not selected. What you are building now is the point; the interview is only the door. You reached that interview, you were not selected, and you are actively building. A person reviews each application. Members get a directory, an asks and offers board, and member-to-member messaging. Nothing about members is public.

records.name: Deepnia
records.tagline: Create, auto-post and grow your social accounts with AI
records.description: Deepnia is an AI studio for creators and small businesses. Describe an idea and get short videos, product ads from your photos, motion design, talking avatars, posters, images, voiceovers and music. Then schedule them on TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, LinkedIn, Threads, Pinterest and Telegram (Pro and Business plans), and see views, likes and comments of every post in one place. Available in English, French, Spanish and Portuguese.

records.name: Seasonal Closet Organizer
records.tagline: Photograph your clothes, box them, find them in seconds
records.description: Seasonal clothes swaps turn into a treasure hunt: identical boxes, lids to open, and the sweater you need is never in the first one. Seasonal Closet Organizer lets you photograph your clothes, store them in boxes with a printable QR label and find any item with a search, even by colour. Guided seasonal swap, hand-me-downs for kids, optional iCloud backup. iPhone and iPad, six languages, no account, data stays on your device. Free up to 10 items, then a one-time purchase.

records.name: Hackathon Radar
records.tagline: Find open hackathons that fit your team, with a fit score
records.description: Hackathon Radar collects open hackathons from 16 public sources, for example Devpost, Devfolio, Kaggle and lablab. It gives each event a fit score from 0 to 100 for your team. The score uses reach, themes, prize, timing and solo entry. Then it reads the rules of the top 80 events to find student-only events, country limits and AI tool rules. You set your team profile in one JSON file. Python standard library only. MIT license.

records.name: BPOM and Web Build Skills for Claude
records.tagline: Agent skills for Indonesian BPOM rules and web builds
records.description: Three open-source Agent Skills for Claude Code, the Claude apps and all agents that read SKILL.md folders. bpom-notifikasi-kosmetika answers questions about BPOM cosmetics notification. It uses the full text of PerBPOM 21/2022 and gives the article. landing-page-design gives your agent a full system for landing pages that convert. component-sourcing selects the UI library. It blocks licenses that you cannot ship, for example AGPL in a web app. MIT license. Install with two commands.

records.name: Brillay
records.tagline: Get paid for the questions your followers already send you
records.description: Brillay is a link-in-bio page for paid questions, custom work and personalized videos, plus tips and goals. Creators set a price and a reply time for each offer. Followers write their request and pay as a guest with just an email, and they're only charged when the creator replies or delivers. Each offer also has its own link, so creators can keep Stan, Linktree or their own site. Free to start: 8% on paid offers, 5% on tips and goals.

records.name: Wander
records.tagline: WYSIWYG Markdown editor for Mac, iPhone and iPad
records.description: Wander is a WYSIWYG Markdown editor for Mac, iPhone and iPad. You write in formatted text, and your notes stay plainmd files in folders you choose. Open an Obsidian vault as it is. Math, Mermaid diagrams, tables and photos render as you type. Your notes sync for free through iCloud Drive or Dropbox, with no account. Wander Cloud is optional: private vaults, sharing, and your notes in ChatGPT and Claude.

records.name: Cardillon
records.tagline: Pop-up greeting cards that really open, sent as a link
records.description: Cardillon is an iPhone and iPad app for pop-up greeting cards with lights and a music box. Pick a card, write your message and send it as a link. They open it with a finger on any phone or computer, no app needed. Your first three cards are free. Android and Windows coming soon.

records.name: Fizzlayer
records.tagline: Open source, self-hostable physical layer for AI agents
records.description: Fizzlayer gives AI agents a way to sense the physical world. Pair a Raspberry Pi, ESP32, phone, or any HTTPS sensor, then ask Fizz in plain English or connect your own agent over MCP. Set a threshold and get a phone call when a reading crosses the line, or when a sensor goes silent. Start free with dashboard alerts; phone calls are included on Tinkerer, Pro, and Enterprise. Fizzlayer is Apache 2.0 licensed, and you can self-host the whole stack with Docker Compose.

records.name: mySHOP
records.tagline: A personal coach for your Etsy shop, in your pocket
records.description: mySHOP gives Etsy sellers a personal coach called Spryte. Ask anything about your shop and get one clear next move, ranked by impact. Spryte scores every listing out of ten with specific fixes, and you can log your expenses by chat, voice or a receipt photo.

records.name: Geaux
records.tagline: DNS filtering, encrypted DNS & WireGuard for iOS
records.description: Geaux puts network control on your iPhone. Filter DNS requests on-device with blocklists and custom rules, choose encrypted DNS with DoH or DNSCrypt, and connect your own WireGuard profile. Inspect allowed, blocked, and cached requests to understand your traffic. Available now in TestFlight beta.

records.name: Vedha
records.tagline: Playwright tests that fail on silent 500s
records.description: Change one import and your existing Playwright tests also fail when the server returned a 5xx or a write failed, even though the page said "Saved". No rewrite, no new assertions. Vedha also ships an MCP server, CLI and SDK so AI agents check the server, not just the screen: each action is verified against the page, the network and a read-back of stored data. Open source, Apache-2.0.

records.name: FreeVoice
records.tagline: Voice rooms for you and your friends, with games built in
records.description: Open a room, share the link, and talk with up to 10 people right in your browser. No account, no download. Play games together while you talk (Seal Deal, Cheat, Sketch Seal, Tencord) or watch YouTube in sync. Add friends to see when they're online and jump into their room in one tap. Voice goes peer-to-peer and encrypted, and nothing is recorded. 39 languages, free.

records.name: Clutch
records.tagline: Pinnacle lines and hit rates for every NBA game
records.description: Clutch is an NBA player prop terminal. Every game of the day with the Pinnacle line, season and last-10 hit rates, injuries and game context. Free calculators and open data studies. Data only, no picks, no betting advice.

records.name: Rutbot
records.tagline: SEO & GEO agents that fix your site, not just audit it
records.description: After 6+ years in SEO, I got tired of tools that hand you 200 problems and wish you luck. Rutbot is a team of AI agents that does the work: it audits your whole site, asks ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Perplexity, Bing Copilot and Google AI Overviews what they say about you, then fixes the issues on your site after you approve, with undo. Connects to WordPress and EasyOrders today; Shopify, WooCommerce, Salla and Zid are next. Any other site gets fixes ready to copy.

records.name: Binqo
records.tagline: A tiny friend in your Mac's notch
records.description: Binqo puts Mielo, a little dot-matrix friend, in your Mac's notch. Glance up for music, calendar, files and clipboard. Hold a key to ask a question, answered on your Mac. Open the desk for meeting notes and mini-apps you describe in a sentence.

records.name: Kovmere
records.tagline: See if AI recommends your business, and what to fix
records.description: Kovmere checks whether AI assistants recommend your business. It asks ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude and Google AI Overviews 18 questions your buyers ask (3 times each), shows who they recommend instead of you and the pages they cite, then gives up to 3 ready-to-use fixes for your site. A Check is $19 one-time with no sign-up, and the report arrives in about 20 minutes. Pro ($49/month) and Agency Portfolio ($129/month) track it every month.

records.name: Monclers
records.tagline: Create AI UGC, edit, and schedule—all in one workspace
records.description: Monclers brings AI avatars, reaction videos, TikTok slideshows, editing, and scheduling into one workspace. Create content without filming, turn ideas into multiple posts, and manage your workflow from creation to publishing.

records.name: Nanachi Remote
records.tagline: Control your Windows coding agents from your phone
records.description: Start a coding session on Windows and pick it up from Android or iPhone. Follow live output, respond to permission requests, review Git changes, and send files to Codex, Claude Code, and other compatible agents. Nanachi Remote is free and open source. The mobile web app connects to your PC over your private Tailscale network. Requires Windows x64 and a configured agent.

records.name: MingOS 命
records.tagline: Ask AI anything about your Bazi chart. Find the right day.
records.description: MingOS computes your Bazi chart on-device and writes one lasting Reading of it, written once and never regenerated, so it doesn't drift. Ask follow-up questions in an AI Consultation grounded in your chart's frozen findings. Use Date Selection to find favourable days, ranked against your chart in an instant month view. Add family and friends; the computed chart is free for everyone. English-first, with Chinese alongside every term.

records.name: Cackles for Android
records.tagline: Live voice rooms for friends on Android and iPhone
records.description: Cackles is live voice rooms for friends and communities, now on Android. Drop in to listen, raise your hand to join the stage, or host a room of your own. Join public or private Bubbles, share room photos and reactions, send direct and group messages, post Stories, and turn on your camera with Portals. One Cackles account works on Android and iPhone, so friends on different phones share the same rooms. Free on Google Play. For adults 18+. Accounts may require community approval.

records.name: Screen Translator
records.tagline: Free on-screen translator for Windows, Mac and Android
records.description: Reads the text on your screen with OCR and draws the translation right over each text block, so you can keep using your computer or phone normally. Translate with Google or DeepL, or fully offline with Argos or TranslateGemma. Shortcuts, a region picker, a game/video mode and speech translation included. Free and open source (MIT).

records.name: PocketBudJet
records.tagline: Private budgeting from your statements — no bank login
records.description: Import CSV, OFX, QFX, QIF, XLSX, or PDF statements. Plan spending, track debt, and spot subscriptions from the same files. Ad-free. Data stays on your phone. 14-day Premium trial, then $9.99/mo or $74.99/yr.

records.name: Travel Chatter: Phrasebook
records.tagline: The phrasebook you write as you go
records.description: Travel Chatter is a travel phrasebook you write as you go. Capture a phrase at any time, in any language, save it to use and learn. No lessons, no streaks - a book that only contains what you choose to put in it.

records.name: Inspiration City
records.tagline: Where people and agents create together
records.description: A shared, persistent workspace where people and agents build real things together. Connect Claude, ChatGPT, Grok, Hermes and more through one MCP connector, and they share your pages, projects and messaging tools, while handing off work to each other.

records.name: HiveFury
records.tagline: Blocks scam sites and keeps your secrets out of AI chats
records.description: HiveFury is the free Chrome extension that guards your browsing and your AI chats. It warns you before known scam and phishing sites, flags fake login pages and checks any site that asks to connect your crypto wallet. Switch on AI data protection and it stops API keys,env andpem files, database connection strings, card numbers and Social Security numbers before they reach an AI chat. Pasted text is checked on your device. Rated 4.8 stars and Featured on the Chrome Web Store.

records.name: Skillbox
records.tagline: One library for your AI skills, synced to every agent
records.description: Skillbox keeps your AI skills in one library and syncs them to Claude Code, Cursor and Codex. Follow GitHub sources, review diffs, and scan each version for prompt injection. Trim shortens noisy command output so sessions last longer.
